findings.description: The added test "supports inherited and replacement child environments" calls Object.assign(process.env, parentEnv) and holds those globals for the full multi-client run (up to 20s). Repo test rules forbid file-wide process.env mutation when a narrower seam exists. This change also exports resolveRpcChildEnv(options, parentEnv) with an injectable parentEnv, so merge/replace semantics can be covered with a direct unit test of that helper and RpcClient integration cases that only pass options.env / envMode, avoiding parallel-suite pollution of MOCK_RPC_* variables.
findings.title: New env-mode integration test mutates global process.env despite an injectable seam
